params.name: process
params.description: Source process number; a negative value addresses the server's interprocess variables from a 4D Client.

constraints: srcVar must be a process or interprocess variable of the source process (local variables are not accepted); the source process must be a user process, not a kernel process.
Does not accept pointers, arrays of pointers, or two-dimensional arrays as source variables.
Each srcVar/dstVar pair must be of compatible types, or the retrieved value is meaningless.

From 4D Client, pass a negative process number to read a stored procedure's interprocess variables on the server without needing to know its process ID; this cross-machine read is only supported client-to-server.
If the source process does not exist, the command has no effect.
